mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the drainage network to the arm was most worthwhile: the planned closeup brings the whole return route together and contrasts ongoing filtration with lymph return.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting route to the vein felt somewhat incremental; its continuous arrows clarified the route, but the preceding picture had already marked the junction.

surprise.text: The tissue-space construction made clear that proteins enter the lymphatic capillaries along with fluid, which is then called lymph.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the marked junction and continuous arrows made the connections understandable, although the compatible-choice menu supplied the possible combinations.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the fluid-accumulation comparison gave the construction a concrete biological purpose, and I would be curious to see another connection developed similarly.
